tool_args.rationale: The five pilot observations have nearly constant s_grad, so the wide-gradient discriminating probe is needed before fitting the heterogeneous siphon parameters.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the smooth siphon model to pilot rows alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The narrow s_grad range makes vmax and rho nearly collinear, preventing reliable identification across gradients.
The immediate ambiguity is gradient leverage and branch selection, not temporal resolution.
The observed monotone concave pilot and matched siphon guidance favor the siphon branch; the discriminating probe can test the open branch.
